   - Investigations planned:
     - MRI right knee (to further evaluate meniscus and intra-articular structures).
   - Treatment planned:
     - Continue acetaminophen as needed (dose/route/frequency not documented).
     - Recommend temporary activity modification and formal physical therapy.
     - Ice and supportive measures as needed.

     - Refer to orthopedic clinic if symptoms persist or worsen.
